answer: The help center names only two forms that started with the February 1, 2026 rewrite. NW-POA-2 (power of attorney) replaced the notarized NW-POA-1, and an NW-POA-1 signed before that date was accepted until June 30, 2026. NW-ODO-2 (odometer disclosure statement) replaced NW-ODO-1. Some older articles still name the retired forms, NW-POA-1 in 'Selling a family member's car for them' and NW-ODO-1 in 'Broken or replaced odometer.' Other forms appear in current articles, such as NW-MIL-1, NW-PU-1 and NW-TRD-1, but the help center doesn't say when they were introduced, so I can't confirm the list is complete; please check with a store.
